knowledge:
- key_parameters: nReads=The number of sequencing reads to simulate ;; genome=A DNAStringSet object or a path to a FASTA file containing the reference genome sequence ;; file=The prefix for output files; if set to "", file creation is prevented and results are returned in R ;; functions=A list of functions to carry out each of the six simulation stages, defaults to defaultFunctions() ;; control=A list of control parameters for each stage, defaults to defaultControl() ;; load=Logical value; if TRUE and intermediate files exist in the working directory, skips previous stages and loads them for re-use
- alternatives: Zhang et al. in silico ChIP-seq simulation=Mentioned as a prior method for transcription factor binding simulation, but ChIPsim is preferred because it separates feature density generation from read sampling, supports nucleosome positioning, and generates strand-specific read densities
- when_to_use: When testing, benchmarking, or comparing ChIP-seq analysis pipelines (including read mapping, peak calling, and feature identification tools) or when estimating the sequencing depth/coverage required for a planned ChIP-seq experiment
- pitfalls: Time-consuming read generation=Simulating a very large number of read sequences can be highly time-consuming; it is recommended to use smaller read counts during testing ;; Custom reconcileFeatures requirements=Any custom implementation of reconcileFeatures must set the overlap parameter (e.g., f$overlap <- 0) and append "ReconciledFeature" to the S3 class vector, otherwise downstream steps will fail ;; Pareto distribution parameter constraint=In custom bindingFeature functions using actuar::rpareto1, the parameter r must be strictly greater than 1

workflows.name: nucleosome_positioning_simulation
workflows.intent: Simulate nucleosome positioning ChIP-seq data using default parameters and a reference genome.
input: genome.fasta (Reference genome sequence in FASTA format)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize random seed and load reference genome ;; 2. Define custom read sequence and quality generation functions ;; 3. Retrieve default simulation functions and customize the read sequence function ;; 4. Run the simulation using simChIP with customized control parameters

workflows.name: transcription_factor_binding_simulation
workflows.intent: Simulate transcription factor binding ChIP-seq data with custom feature generation, transition probabilities, and strand-specific read densities.
input: genome.fasta (Reference genome sequence in FASTA format)
workflows.stages: 1. Define transition probabilities and initial state distributions ;; 2. Define feature generator functions for background and binding states ;; 3. Define custom reconcileFeatures and featureDensity functions ;; 4. Define fragment length distribution function ;; 5. Run the simulation using simChIP with custom feature and read density arguments
